name: Harsh Mentor (Marshal Archetype)
body:
While often rough around the edges, these marshals keep their comrades in shape and support them with devastating unarmed strikes.

Hard Right Hand (Ex)

At 1st level, a harsh mentor knows the power of a well placed fist. They gain Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat. In addition, whenever they damage a creature with an unarmed strike (lethal or non lethal), they may choose to grant the target a +2 bonus on Will saves and attack rolls until their next turn or cause the creature to make a Fortitude save (DC of 10 + 1/2 the harsh mentor’s class level + their Strength modifier) or become sickened for one round. If a creature saves against this sickened effect, it becomes immune for the next 24 hours. Additionally, a harsh mentor deals damage with their unarmed strikes as though they were a monk of their class level. Harsh mentors ready one fewer aura each day.

Heavy Metal (Ex)

At 4th level, through long use and familiarity with armor, a harsh mentor adds any armor enhancement bonus to AC to their unarmed attack and damage rolls as an enhancement bonus as long as the armor is primarily made of metal and normally comes with gauntlets. A harsh mentor treats gauntlets and spiked gauntlets as unarmed strikes for all abilities and feats which use unarmed strikes. This means gauntlets enchanted as weapons can be used for unarmed strikes, including the harsh mentor’s improved unarmed strike damage. Additionally, a harsh mentor is considered a fighter of their class level for the purpose of feat prerequisites.

This ability replaces tactician.

Proper Leverage (Ex)

At 8th level, a harsh mentor’s mastery of hand to hand combat can also inspire onlookers. A harsh mentor adds 1 and 1/2 times their Strength modifier to damage rolls with unarmed strikes and gauntlet attacks as well as combat maneuver checks made to disarm, drag, grapple, reposition, or trip. When a harsh mentor deals damage using their unarmed damage or successfully uses one of the listed combat maneuvers, they may spend a use of inspire action as a swift action to grant all allies within 60 feet a +2 bonus on the next attack roll or combat maneuver check they make before the harsh mentor’s next turn. At 16th level, this bonus increases to +4.

This ability replaces the bonus teamwork feats gained at 8th and 16th levels.

Smashing Strike (Ex)

At 12th level, a harsh mentor can deliver truly devastating strikes. As a standard action, a harsh mentor may make a single attack that uses their unarmed damage. If the attack hits, they may make a combat maneuver check. On a success, they push their target back 10 feet backwards plus 5 feet for every 5 they beat the target’s CMD. If the target is pushed back they also make a Reflex save (DC of 10 + 1/2 the harsh mentor’s class level + their Strength modifier). Failure means the target is knocked prone. A harsh mentor may also use this ability when benefiting from the Vital Strike, Improved Vital Strike, or Greater Vital Strike feats.

This ability replaces greater tactician.

Inspiring Juggernaut (Ex)

At 20th level, a harsh mentor’s feats have garnered such a reputation that their presence heartens all they call allies on the battlefield. Allies within the harsh mentor’s aura radius become immune to fear, fatigue, exhaustion, and any effect that would reduce them 0 hit points or render them unconscious without dealing damage. In any round in which the harsh mentor reduces an enemy to 0 or fewer hit points with an unarmed strike, they may make an Intimidate check against all enemies in their aura radius as a free action.

This ability replaces master tactician.
